name: 9 Degrees Alexandria
notes: Official 9degrees.com.au locations page. Alexandria block matches all 7 days (Mon 10am-10pm, Tue 4pm-10pm, Wed 6am-10pm, Thu/Fri 10am-10pm, weekends 8am-9pm). Chatswood-only temporary closure notice ignored.

name: BlocHaus Marrickville
notes: Official BlocHaus Sydney site (Marrickville MKV + Leichhardt LCT). MKV: Mon&Fri 6am-10pm, Tue-Thu 6am-11pm, Sat/Sun 8am-10pm - matches. Open daily except Xmas/NY Day.

name: La Roca Boulders
notes: Official site. Staffed hours Mon-Fri 11:30am-9:30pm, weekends 9am-7pm match; gym also has a 24/7 key-access annex (members only) which is not reflected in recorded hours, arguably fine.

name: Northside Boulders
notes: Official site covers 3 gyms. Brunswick and Northcote both list Mon-Fri 7am-10pm, Sat-Sun 10am-7pm (matches record); Abbotsford (Lactic Factory) differs (Mon-Fri 4:30-9:30pm, Sat-Sun 11am-6pm) so record is only correct if it is Brunswick/Northcote. Page also shows a 'Brunswick re-opening event' banner.

name: Bayside Rock Climbing
differences: sat: recorded (missing) vs site 10am-8pm (footer Hours block) / 9am-6pm (Trading Hours page main text); holiday-trading text says 9am-8pm
sun: recorded (missing) vs site 10am-5pm (footer) / 9am-5pm (Trading Hours page main text)
notes: Mon-Fri 10am-9:30pm matches, but record omits Saturday and Sunday which the site lists. The site itself is internally inconsistent on weekend hours (footer vs trading-hours page; school-holiday block lists Sat 9-6, Sun 9-5).

name: VITAL Climbing Gym – West Harlem
notes: Official VITAL page for West Harlem & Upper East Side. West Harlem: Mon-Fri 8am-11pm, Sat-Sun 9am-10pm matches (UES has different hours, not used).

name: Benchmark Climbing – Berkeley
notes: Official site locations page. Berkeley: Mon-Fri 7am-10pm, Sat-Sun 10am-7pm matches.

name: Brooklyn Bouldering Project
notes: Official Bouldering Project Gowanus page (575 Degraw St). Mon-Fri 6am-10pm, Sat-Sun 8am-8pm matches.

name: Mosaic Boulders
notes: Official site. Public Mon-Fri 1pm-11pm, Sat-Sun 11am-11pm matches (member-only 9am-1pm weekdays correctly excluded).

name: Sender One Climbing – Lakewood
notes: Official Lakewood page. Mon-Fri 6am-11pm, Sat/Sun 8am-6pm matches.

name: Boulderdash Indoor Rock Climbing
notes: Official Boulderdash site, Thousand Oaks location page (880 Hampshire Rd). Mon-Fri 11am-10pm, Sat 10am-8pm, Sun 10am-6pm matches. Note: Thousand Oaks is in Ventura County, labelled metro Los Angeles.

name: Rockreation – Los Angeles
notes: Official site; LA gym hours Mon/Wed/Fri 12pm-10pm, Tue/Thu 6am-10pm, Sat/Sun 10am-4pm match (Costa Mesa shows identical hours).

name: The Post Climbing
notes: Official Touchstone page (Pasadena). M-Th 7am-11pm, F 7am-10pm, Sat/Sun 10am-7pm public matches (members-only Sat/Sun 9-10am excluded). Hours also confirmed on location-hours page.

name: BlocHaus Bouldering
notes: Official BlocHaus Melbourne site. Mon/Wed/Fri 6am-10pm, Tue/Thu 10am-10pm, Sat/Sun 9am-9pm matches.

name: Sender One Climbing – Playa Vista
notes: Official Playa Vista page. Mon-Fri 12pm-10pm, Sat 10am-7pm, Sun 10am-7pm matches.

name: NOMAD Bouldering
notes: Official NOMAD Annandale page. Weekdays 6am-10pm, weekends 8am-9:30pm matches (public holidays 8am-10pm not recorded; fine).

name: BlocHaus Leichhardt
notes: Official BlocHaus Sydney site. LCT: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 10am-10pm, Wed 6am-10pm, Sat/Sun 8am-10pm matches.

name: Pacific Pipe
notes: Official Touchstone Pacific Pipe page (Oakland). M/W/F 7am-10pm, T/Th 7am-11pm, S/S 10am-7pm matches (members-only 9-10am weekend excluded).
